subject: Quantitative Aptitude
question: If a circle has a radius of 7 cm, what is its circumference? (Take pi = 22/7)
solution: Circumference = 2 * pi * r = 2 * (22/7) * 7 = 44 cm. Topic (Mensuration) is in the SSC CGL syllabus. Source: https://ssc.gov.in/api/assets/uploads/master-data/Syllabus/Syllabus_CGL_2024.pdf
author: Hermes
